summary: Anthropic announced a multi-year alliance with DXC Technology to train tens of thousands of Claude-certified engineers and embed Claude-powered agentic systems into DXC's IT services and its regulated-industry customers' operations.

mechanisms.reason: DXC is deploying Claude-based AI agents to handle routine operational work and subagents for security operations, shifting work from human operators to agentic systems inside enterprise IT environments.
mechanisms.quote: DXC launched DXC OASIS, its tool for running customers' IT systems, where AI agents handle much of the routine work.

mechanisms.reason: Rolling Claude out across DXC's 115,000 employees and over 50 enterprise customers implies a large increase in aggregate inference calls, though no volume figures are disclosed.
mechanisms.quote: OASIS now serves over 50 DXC customers, and the firm plans to roll it out to customers around the world.
